title: Indices outside a fixed set
statement: For a finite index set $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the indices outside $J$ are the elements $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ satisfying $i\notin J$.
